added.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

The organization operates in the education technology sector, addressing challenges related to effectively communicating product value and driving market engagement. It focuses on developing strategic marketing approaches to enhance product awareness and growth within competitive education markets.

About the Opportunity:

The SPECIALIST, PRODUCT MARKETING will lead efforts to bring products to market through targeted marketing programs with a focus on product marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), and growth initiatives. The role is responsible for crafting clear product positioning and messaging, executing integrated campaigns, and driving engagement with key audiences. This position contributes to the organization by translating market and customer insights into impactful marketing strategies that support business growth.

Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain product positioning, messaging, value propositions, and differentiators.
Translate product features into customer benefits and outcomes.
Support go-to-market strategies and product launches with targeted messaging and campaigns.
Create messaging frameworks tailored to audiences, personas, and accounts.
Develop and execute ABM strategies focused on high-value accounts and growth opportunities.
Design account- and segment-specific strategies to drive awareness and conversion.
Translate marketing strategies into multi-channel campaigns.
Support campaign execution across email, digital, social, web, webinars, events, and retargeting.
Develop and adapt content including email campaigns, blogs, case studies, webinars, and collateral.
Ensure consistency of product and campaign messaging across channels.
Analyze market insights to improve segmentation and targeting.
Use performance data to optimize messaging, content, and channel strategies.

3 to 7+ years of experience in marketing, product marketing, education technology, or related fields.
Strong writing and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex product information.
Experience in developing and executing integrated digital marketing campaigns.

Strong project management skills and ability to handle multiple priorities.

added.title: SEO & Digital Acquisition Specialist
added.description:
About MCU:

At Municipal Credit Union, we believe that an incredible culture helps create a happy and motivated team that works hard to achieve the best results for themselves and their members. For more than 100 years, MCU has provided affordable financial products and convenient services to a membership base that is now comprised of over 600,000 individuals. With each new generation we have the pleasure of interacting with, we maintain the credit union promise of people helping people.

Our Mission:

To help hard-working New Yorkers build better tomorrows

Our Vision:

Be New York's most loved financial institution by helping our members build their best financial futures

Overview:
The SEO & Digital Acquisition Specialist executes MCU's organic and paid search presence across its website properties. This role bridges brand strategy and technical execution, ensuring assigned web properties attract high-intent traffic across both traditional search engines and AI-driven answer and generative surfaces, engaging visitors, and converting leads effectively. Reporting to the Manager, Digital Marketing, this role is responsible for day-to-day SEO execution, coordinates paid search and programmatic activities in partnership with external agency partners, and supports analytics implementation and site performance reporting.

Responsibilities
:

Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

Technical SEO: Execute technical SEO activities for the site, including crawlability, indexation, site architecture, page speed/Core Web Vitals, and schema/structured data markup.
On-Site SEO & AI Search Visibility (AEO/GEO): Execute on-page SEO execution (keyword strategy, content optimization, and internal linking) and extend that work to Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), structuring content and site elements to improve visibility and citation in AI-driven answer and generative surfaces (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity).
Local SEO & Listings Management: Maintain and optimize Google Business Profile and other local listings for MCU branch locations, supporting visibility for new branch openings and location-based search.
Paid Search & Programmatic Strategy: Serve as the internal subject-matter expert for MCU's paid search and programmatic advertising (e.g., via The Trade Desk or similar DSPs). Partner with external paid media agencies — reviewing keyword/audience strategy, bidding approach, and creative testing recommendations, and assessing performance against MCU's goals. Day-to-day campaign execution is managed by agency partners; this role provides recommendations and performance analysis.
Content & Brand Consistency: Ensure website content aligns with MCU's overall brand strategy and voice across marketing channels. Write clear, concise, and grammatically correct website copy consistent with MCU's brand voice.
Site Performance & Reporting: Track and report on site and campaign performance against engagement and conversion targets set by marketing leadership, including conversion rate optimization (CRO) recommendations and testing. Contribute recommendations and flag optimization opportunities.
Tagging, Analytics & Privacy Compliance: Manage day-to-day administration of Google Tag Manager (GTM), including tag, trigger, and variable configuration, and help ensure tracking implementation aligns with evolving privacy requirements (e.g., consent management, first-party data strategies).
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with design, product, content, and other marketing team members, as well as vendor partners, to align web messaging with marketing campaigns and broader projects.
Content Governance: Ensure all web content remains accurate, up to date, on-brand, and compliant with accessibility standards (such as ADA/WCAG).
Additional Responsibilities: Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

Requirements
:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience will also be considered.
4-6+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience, with a strong focus on digital channels, website management, SEO, paid search, and analytics. Financial services experience preferred but not required.
Strong working knowledge of Content Management Systems (CMS), preferably HubSpot.
Working knowledge of web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, etc.).
Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager (GTM), including tag, trigger, and variable configuration.
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and web production fundamentals.
Technical SEO knowledge (crawlability, indexation, site architecture, page speed, schema/structured data markup).
Working knowledge of AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). optimizing content and site structure for visibility in AI-driven search and answer surfaces (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews).
Experience managing Google Business Profile or other local listings platforms.
Strong working knowledge of paid search and programmatic strategy (bidding automation, audience targeting, campaign structure) sufficient to direct and evaluate agency-managed campaigns, without requiring hands-on platform execution.
Experience working with or managing external paid media/programmatic agency partners (e.g., platforms like The Trade Desk) preferred.
Familiarity with privacy and consent-management frameworks affecting tracking (e.g., Consent Mode).
Excellent written, verbal, and digital communication skills, with superior proofreading and editing ability.
Strong project management and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform in a high-volume environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
Must be able to work independently on multiple assignments concurrently, contribute recommendations grounded in data, and execute against company and departmental objectives.

Why you'll be a good fit:

Our Core Values are an integral part of who we are and who we hire. By living our Core Values, every day, we continue to attract the best and brightest talent, achieve unsurpassed results and continuously challenge ourselves to be better than yesterday. These values are at the heart of our organization and within every teammate. To be a great fit, you’ll bring the following

Results
- We are passionate about winning.

Agility
- We proactively anticipate, respond and pivot to ensure MCU wins.

Integrity
- We operate with the highest ethical standards and highest degree of honesty.

Belonging
- We cultivate a culture of inclusion and teamwork.

Ownership
- We take personal responsibility and hold ourselves accountable for the results.

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

The pay range for this position is between $71,600-116,550 annually. Actual base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Employees in this position may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus, 401(k) with an 6% employer match per pay period. Benefits for this position include Medical, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance, flexible paid time off and 11 paid holidays annually.

Municipal Credit Union (MCU) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Municipal Credit Union provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

We are committed to hiring, training, cultivating, promoting, and celebrating an environment where we have a welcoming and fulfilling place for all people to call home. Diversity of race, thought, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, religion, and disability will empower us to thrive as individuals, as teams, and as an organization.

added.title: Digital Marketing Manager, Strategic Communications
added.description:
Who We Are

For over 30 years, CSH has changed the lives of people who have been marginalized and are our most vulnerable neighbors by:

Helping communities create over 467,600 homes for individuals and families who did not have one;
Bringing hope to thousands who thought they would live on the streets or reside in institutions; and
Ensuring not only a stable home for each, but access to the services that brought healthcare, recovery and training to their doorsteps.

CSH has proven supportive housing can change the lives of individuals, families, and communities. We have created a team of nationally recognized experts who are dedicated to our organization and its goals. We offer competitive salaries and benefits, generous leave and paid time off, and fully embrace the philosophy that work-life balance is achievable. With the goal of attracting proven candidates committed to making a difference and who aspire to advance our mission, CSH is now accepting applications for a Digital Marketing Manager
.

Why We Need You

CSH is seeking a results-oriented individual committed to sharing their talent to support a mission-driven organization that leads efforts to expand housing and service solutions for highly impacted populations. CSH is looking for a skilled digital marketer and strong writer who can help us reach and engage more people with our work. You'll lead email marketing, manage and optimize web content, strengthen our visibility in traditional and AI-powered search, and use data and testing to continually improve performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining technology, content, creativity, and analysis in support of a mission. This position will be hybrid based in the New York City metro area.

What You Will Do

The Digital Marketing Manager leads CSH's email marketing, website content, search optimization, and digital performance efforts. This hands-on role develops and improves digital campaigns that engage priority audiences, increase the reach and discoverability of CSH's content, and translate data into better marketing decisions.

Working closely with the Strategic Communications team and colleagues across the organization, the Digital Marketing Manager combines excellent writing and editing with strong digital marketing, analytical, and project-management skills. The role also helps CSH adopt emerging practices in AI-enabled marketing, communications, and search.

Email Marketing & Audience Engagement (30%)

Manage the planning, execution, and evaluation of email marketing campaigns, newsletters, event promotions, fundraising communications, and organizational announcements.
Build, test, deploy, and optimize email campaigns using marketing automation and email marketing platforms.
Develop and maintain audience lists, segmentation strategies, subscription management processes, contact engagement and re-engagement strategies, and audience data hygiene.
Design and analyze A/B testing of subject lines, content, calls to action, and other campaign tactics to improve engagement, conversions, and overall campaign performance.
Monitor campaign metrics, engagement trends, deliverability, list health, and audience behavior and recommend strategies to improve email performance.

Website Management & Content Optimization (25%)

Manage, edit, and optimize website content for three primary websites to , ensure it is clear, accurate, current, accessible, audience-focused and aligned with organizational priorities.
Create and update webpages, landing pages, forms, and other digital assets to support organizational initiatives and campaigns.
Conduct regular website content audits and recommend improvements to user experience, accessibility, navigation, and content organization.
Collaborate with staff across the organization to publish and maintain timely content, resources, announcements, and event information.
Monitor website performance and user behavior metrics to identify opportunities for improved engagement and effectiveness.

Search Optimization (SEO, AEO, and GEO) (15%)

Apply SEO and emerging AI-search practices to improve CSH content visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search and answer experiences.
Conduct keyword and audience-intent research and optimize content, metadata, page structure, and internal linking to improve discoverability.
Stay current on evolving search trends, digital marketing practices, and emerging technologies, recommending practical applications for CSH.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization (15%)

Track, analyze, and report on digital marketing performance across email, website, and other digital channels.
Develop and maintain regular dashboards, reports, and performance summaries for key stakeholders.
Translate data and performance metrics into actionable recommendations that improve campaign outcomes and audience engagement.
Monitor key performance indicators, identify trends, and evaluate the effectiveness of marketing and communications efforts.
Support organizational decision-making by providing timely, accurate, and meaningful digital marketing insights.

Content & Campaign Support (15%)

Apply web writing and content design best practices to improve readability, page structure, calls to action, and user journeys.
Collaborate with Strategic Communications staff and colleagues across the organization to develop and implement integrated marketing and communications campaigns.
Use AI-enabled tools to support appropriate aspects of research, content development, search optimization, audience insights, testing, and workflow efficiency, while maintaining human review for accuracy, quality, privacy, and brand alignment.
Support the promotion of events, initiatives, publications, trainings, thought leadership content, and organizational announcements across digital channels.
Partner with subject matter experts to translate complex information into clear, engaging, and accessible content for target audiences.
Assist with content development, copyediting, proofreading, and quality assurance across digital platforms.
Ensure digital content reflects CSH brand standards, messaging guidance, accessibility requirements, and quality expectations.
Coordinate project timelines, manage competing priorities, and communicate project status with internal stakeholders.
Recommend improvements to digital marketing processes, workflows, and practices to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Other duties, assignments, projects, and research as needed.

How We Work

CSH staff are adaptable, entrepreneurial, creative, and flexible problem-solvers. We are strategic thinkers committed to treating each other and the communities we serve with respect. You should share a passion for the CSH mission and possess the skills to meet the expectation of this role to help shape how we share our ambitious mission.

Specifically, We Are Seeking

Five or more years of relevant experience in digital marketing, communications, or marketing.
Demonstrated experience managing email campaigns, including segmentation, A/B testing, audience engagement, and performance analysis.
Experience managing and optimizing website content through a CMS such as WordPress or Drupal.
Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, including the ability to translate complex information into compelling digital content.
Working knowledge of SEO and web content optimization, with interest and experience in emerging AEO and GEO practices.
Experience using digital analytics to evaluate performance and recommend improvements.
Strong project-management skills and ability to manage competing priorities in a collaborative environment.
Experience with digital marketing technologies and curiosity about emerging AI-enabled marketing and communications practices.

Compensation

CSH offers generous benefits, opportunities for professional growth, and competitive salaries based on geographic location. Our range for Digital Marketing Manager located in the New York City is $114,000-$128,000.

Our ranges are broad, and it is customary for candidates to join CSH at the lower half of the range to leave room for growth, learning, and development in the role and range. Pay rates are set using a 50-mile metro area approach; the ranges could vary up or down based on a candidate’s location. It is uncommon for salaries to fall above the mid-point at the time of hire. We negotiate actual salaries with final candidates based on their exact location, experience in similar roles, and expertise related to the qualifications. This information is offered in support of our commitment to transparency.

Interested in joining our team as a leader in the national supportive housing movement?

To Apply:
Candidates should apply through the link. All candidates should attach their Resume, Cover Letter, and Salary Expectations as one Microsoft Word or PDF document.

added.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
added.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.

Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to grow Roo's business with independent veterinary hospitals. You'll own hospital growth across the full funnel: how practice owners and managers discover Roo, why they sign up, what gets them to post and fill their first shift, and what keeps them coming back.

You'll be accountable for bringing hospitals onto Roo and turning them into active, repeat customers, with success measured by hospitals that activate and stay active alongside sign-ups and leads. As the business unit's first dedicated growth marketer, you'll shape the growth strategy, own the growth budget and measurement, and lead testing across the hospital journey.

You'll report to the GM of Independent Hospitals, with a dotted line to the Marketing leadership and be part of Roo's marketing guild, which owns craft standards for marketing across the company.

Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Planning

Shape the strategy.
Shape the hospital growth strategy with the GM and product, setting goals for acquisition, activation, reactivation, and expansion, plus acquisition cost and payback targets tied to hospitals that fill shifts and keep posting.
Own the budget.
Own the hospital growth budget and channel mix, allocating spend by market tier based on where shifts are most likely to fill, and deciding what to scale, what to cut, and what should wait.

Acquisition

Own hospital channels.
This covers both acquisition motions: B2B lead generation and account-based campaigns with sales, and direct-to-practice-manager acquisition through paid search and social. It also covers direct mail, referrals, sponsorships, buying-group partnerships, and SEO and AEO priorities, partnering with brand on the build.
Own hospital acquisition campaigns.
Own hospital-only acquisition campaigns, and bring the acquisition layer to company-wide campaigns led by the brand team.
Partner on events.
Partner with the brand and community teams on conferences, industry events, and webinars, bringing the hospital targeting and shaping the follow-up that turns attendees into active hospitals.
Target the right hospitals.
Partner with sales, Rev Ops, and analytics on hospital targeting and lead scoring, so marketing, the field team, and automated outreach focus on the hospitals most likely to fill and grow.
Own the field handoff.
Set lead routing, handoff SLAs, and the rules for which hospitals get a Hospital Success Partner (HSP) and which get AI-driven outreach.

Activation & Conversion

Get hospitals to first fill.
Own the CRO backlog, test roadmap, and first-fill playbook across the hospital journey, from landing pages and sign-up to approval and first shift posted, partnering with product on the sign-up and first-shift experience.
Partner on product experiments.
Work with product and growth analysts to develop, launch, and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments, such as homepage banners and headline tests.
Find where hospitals drop off.
Diagnose where and why hospitals drop off, using funnel data alongside what practice owners, managers, and the field team say, and turn what you learn into fixes.
Shape activation journeys.
Partner with the lifecycle team on onboarding and activation journeys, bringing the audience insight, goals, and offers that shape them.
Make the incentive case.
Partner with the pricing team on incentive strategy: which hospitals get one, what offer, and the payback against hospital LTV.
Brief the creative.
Partner with brand on campaign creative, landing pages, and website updates, bringing clear briefs, audience insight, and performance learnings that shape the work.
Sharpen the message.
Partner with product marketing and brand on hospital positioning and messaging, and bring channel and test results back to sharpen it.

Retention & Expansion

Win back dormant hospitals.
Own the reactivation campaign for dormant, churned, and unfilled-shift hospitals, partnering with the lifecycle team on the journeys and messaging that bring them back to Roo.
Grow existing accounts.
Build expansion programs that help hospitals use Roo more often and book across more roles, such as adding veterinary technicians.

Measurement & Insights

Own the numbers.
Own hospital growth measurement, including the model that tracks acquisition cost by channel, cohort activation, fill rates, lifetime value, and payback, the holdout standard every program is measured against, and the attribution and tests with clear success criteria that show what each program actually drove.
Report and adjust.
Read results honestly, move investment toward what's working, and share progress, spend, and learnings with business unit and marketing leadership.

How This Role Works With the Team

This role sits at the center of the business unit and works through others. You'll partner with the Hospital Success Partner field team on who to target and how leads get routed, and with product and growth analysts on experiments and the sign-up and first-shift experience. You'll also work with product marketing on positioning, lifecycle on activation and reactivation journeys, pricing on first-fill incentives, analytics on targeting and measurement, and brand and community on creative, the website, events, and webinars. Because fill depends on veterinary professional supply, you'll work closely with the Veterinary Marketplace business unit so hospital demand and supply grow in the same markets. You'll bring these teams together around a shared growth plan.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will:

Grow hospital acquisition against plan and within budget.
Increase the share of new hospitals that post and fill their first shift.
Grow the number of hospitals posting regularly on Roo.
Bring dormant hospitals back to active use, in partnership with the lifecycle team.
Set a clear measure for every channel and move investment toward what works.
Build a testing roadmap and first-fill playbook the business unit runs on.

Qualifications

Full-funnel growth experience.
Experience in growth or performance marketing to small businesses, ideally at a marketplace or vertical SaaS company. You've owned a budget and a channel mix.
Outcome ownership.
You've been held to a number beyond the click, like activation, first purchase or retained customers, and you've changed your spend because of it. You defend spend in CAC, payback and LTV.
B2B channel range.
Hands-on with paid search and social, sponsorships, partnerships, referrals and direct mail, and you know when to cut a channel. Bonus if you've run account-based plays for high-priority accounts alongside broad demand gen.
Root-cause thinking.
You've diagnosed why customers sign up and don't activate, and improved conversion by fixing the root cause.
Field sales partnership.
You've worked alongside a sales or account team on lead scoring, routing and handoffs, and you can tell which touches actually move the number.
Market-level thinking.
You're comfortable allocating spend by geography and you understand that in a two-sided marketplace, demand only pays off where supply exists.
Experimentation and measurement rigor.
You can show what your campaigns actually caused. You design tests with real controls, set up attribution and holdouts, pull and analyze the data yourself, read results honestly, and have reported a negative result to leadership.
Customer understanding.
You understand how small business owners and practice managers make decisions, you write clearly and credibly for busy practice owners and managers, and you write a sharp brief.
Influential partnership.
You get alignment across sales, product, PMM, lifecycle, pricing and data without formal authority.
Startup-ready.
You thrive in ambiguity and enjoy building programs from scratch.
AI fluency.
You use AI to scale your own output and have a view on where agents can replace manual outreach.
Bonus.
Experience in veterinary medicine, healthcare, marketplaces, or staffing is a plus.

Why Roo

Be the first dedicated growth marketer for Roo's hospital business and build the program from the ground up.
Own the full hospital funnel, from first touch to repeat use.
Help hospitals get the support they need and help veterinary professionals find flexible, meaningful work.
Partner closely with an ambitious team that values first-principles thinking, ownership, and continuous improvement.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Please see below for compensation ranges based on our geographical tiering system recommended by external benchmark data (with example cities listed).

Note: We’ve recently been made aware of a job scam where scammers are posing as Roo employees and conducting fake text interviews. Please note that any communication from @lifeatroo.com
is not legitimate
. All official Roo communication will always come from @roo.vet
.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Tier 2 Pay Range (examples: LA, Boston, Seattle, DC, San Diego, Chicago): $125,000 USD - $175,000 USD

Tier 3 Pay Range (examples: Austin, Dallas, Portland, Denver, Philadelphia, Baltimore, Sacramento): $120,000 USD - $165,000 USD

Tier 5 Pay Range (examples: Madison, Birmingham, San Antonio, Spokane, Toronto): $105,000 USD - $145,000 USD

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

Located in the US:

For permanent, full time employees, we offer:

Accelerated growth & learning potential.
Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.
Comprehensive health benefits to fit your needs with base medical plan covered at 100% with optional premium buy up plans.
401K
Unlimited Paid Time Off.
Paid Maternity/Paternity and reproductive care leave.
Gifts on your birthday & anniversary.
Opportunity for domestic travel, including for regional team building events.

Located in Canada:

For permanent, full time employees, we offer:

Accelerated growth & learning potential.
Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.
Comprehensive health benefits offered through Rippling EOR.
Registered Retirement Savings Plans (RRSPs) and Tax-Free Savings Accounts (TFSAs) through Wealthsimple.
Unlimited Paid Time Off.
Paid Maternity/Paternity and reproductive care leave.
Gifts on your birthday & anniversary.
Opportunity for domestic travel, including for regional team building events.

Overall, you would be part of a mission-driven company that will significantly empower the lives of all veterinary professionals and the health of the overall animal industry that seeks massive innovation.

We have diverse, passionate & driven team members from a variety of backgrounds, and Roo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, se

added.title: Digital Demand Generation Manager
added.description:
About Glia

Glia is the #1 Banking AI platform, empowering community and regional financial institutions to create efficiencies, accelerate loan growth, drive deposits, and deliver experiences that win against megabanks and fintechs.

Glia's Banking AI Operating System is a central intelligence layer on top of existing tech stacks, activating an AI workforce of specialized agents that draw from banking data, interaction history, and integrated systems of record. These banking-trained agents automate workflows across voice and digital–from front office to back office–resulting in decreased operational costs and the Universal Banker model.

Trusted by 700+ banks and credit unions for its ironclad security and reliability, Glia delivers the industry’s first contractual no-hallucination guarantee. It’s why Glia customers quickly and confidently put Banking AI to work with measurable results from day one. More information about Glia can be found at glia.com.

The Role

At Glia, we believe banking is personal—and our marketing should be too. As the Digital Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in fueling our demand generation engine. In this role, your primary focus will be leading our virtual events and webinar strategy—serving as the end-to-end strategist, producer, and marketer for our live digital programs.

In addition to leading our webinar program, you will manage our paid online advertising channels and content syndication programs to amplify our reach, nurture prospects, and generate qualified leads across the marketing funnel.

What You’ll Do

Webinar & Virtual Event Leadership

Program Strategy: Plan, schedule, and execute a high-performing webinar schedule, designed to attract engagement from prospects and customers.
End-to-End Production: Manage all pre- and post-production logistics, including setting up event landing pages, speaker prep, rehearsals, tech checks, live moderation, and audience Q&A.
Promotion & Audience Acquisition: Build multi-channel promotional strategies (email cadences, paid social, internal promotion) to maximize live attendance and on-demand views.
Post-Event Activation: Lead post-webinar follow-up workflows and repackage webinar recordings into evergreen lead assets.

Paid Online Advertising

added.title: VP of Marketing
added.description:
Description

Join our team as a VP of Marketing and help virtualize biological experiments to accelerate discovery!

Location:
Remote - US East Coast

Reports to:
Chief Business Officer

About Turbine

A lab without limits, built for biopharma.

Turbine’s Virtual Lab (vLab®) enables scientists to run Virtual Assays across millions of biological conditions far beyond traditional laboratory throughput. Instead of narrowing hypotheses to fit experimental constraints, scientists can explore the broader biological search space computationally before deciding what to validate in the wet lab. Turbine doesn’t replace the wet lab. It makes every experiment count. Through an integrated lab-in-the-loop workflow, virtual findings become testable hypotheses, with validation results feeding back to strengthen subsequent predictions within the workflow.

In deployed programs, Turbine has reduced decision timelines from 12-18 months to approximately two months while cutting wet-lab experiments by more than 50%.

Working with scientists at leading biopharma like MSD (Merck & Co.), AstraZeneca and Bayer, Turbine’s virtual assays have rationalized experiments across more than 30 discovery programs.

Backed by leading tech and industry investors like Accel, MSD Global Health Innovation Fund, Interactive Venture Partners and Beiersdorf, Turbine is turning biology into an engineering discipline.

About The Role

Turbine is seeking a strategic VP of Marketing to build the company's reputation and market position as a leader in BioAI and virtual biology
, translating our scientific and commercial differentiation into a clear corporate narrative, strong executive presence, and increased engagement with leading biopharma organizations.

A central mandate will be to elevate the external profiles of Turbine's founders and leadership team and establish them as credible, distinctive voices in BioAI and the future of pharmaceutical R&D.

The VP of Marketing will provide the strategic marketing leadership required as Turbine scales commercially and expands its technology across modalities and therapeutic areas. They will act as a strategic advisor to the CEO, founders, CBO, and wider leadership team on positioning, external communications, executive visibility, and market engagement.

The VP will lead Turbine's marketing function, setting strategy and direction across corporate and product marketing while developing a high-performing team focused on product marketing, scientific content, conferences, and sales enablement.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Strategy, Positioning & Brand

Own and continuously sharpen Turbine's corporate positioning and market narrative.
Define Turbine's overarching corporate narrative and category positioning.
Establish clear, differentiated messaging around virtual biology, Virtual Cells, Virtual Assays, and Virtual Lab.
Translate sophisticated science and technology into compelling and accessible market narratives.
Clearly differentiate Turbine within the AI drug discovery, virtual cell, and broader TechBio landscape.
Ensure consistency across corporate, product, scientific, and commercial communications.
Build and maintain a differentiated corporate brand and consistent visual and verbal identity as the company and product portfolio expand.
Monitor market, customer, and competitive developments and translate these insights into positioning and go-to-market strategy.

Founder & Executive Thought Leadership

Build a systematic thought-leadership platform around Turbine's founders and leadership team.
Develop distinct thought-leadership territories for priority executives.
Identify and secure relevant speaking, media, podcast, panel, and authorship opportunities.
Develop executive narratives, talking points, and opinion pieces.
Prepare executives for high-profile external engagements.
Build relationships with conference organizers, industry influencers, and relevant ecosystem leaders.
Position Turbine executives as credible and sought-after voices on AI, biology, and the future of pharmaceutical R&D.
Work with external agencies and internal teams to deliver consistent and sustained executive visibility.

PR, Communications & BioAI Ecosystem

Own Turbine's global PR and external communications strategy.
Build direct relationships with influential biopharma, biotech, technology, and AI journalists and editors.
Lead and manage external PR and communications partners.
Develop proactive media narratives beyond company announcements and press releases.
Build communications programs around scientific results, partnerships, funding, product developments, and customer milestones.
Maximize the impact of corporate announcements through targeted media engagement and follow-on coverage.
Generate proactive earned-media opportunities around relevant industry developments and conversations.
Manage corporate announcements and issues communications.
Increase high-quality earned media coverage and Turbine's share of voice in BioAI and virtual biology.

Commercial Marketing & Account Engagement

Partner closely with Business Development and Product Marketing to translate Turbine's positioning into commercial impact.
Develop marketing strategies for priority biopharma accounts, therapeutic areas, and use cases.
Use account-based marketing and targeted campaigns to increase engagement within strategic accounts.
Coordinate executive, conference, content, and digital activity around priority accounts.
Develop messaging and campaigns around customer needs and commercial priorities.
Drive measurable marketing contribution to qualified pipeline and strategic-account engagement.
Use customer, market, and competitive insights to inform marketing and commercial strategy.
Turn customer proof points and scientific results into compelling commercial narratives in partnership with Business Development, Product, and scientific teams.

Marketing Leadership & Operations

Own the annual marketing strategy, priorities, operating plan, and budget.
Establish clear corporate and product marketing objectives and measurable KPIs.
Prioritize investment across PR, thought leadership, conferences, content, digital, and account-based marketing.
Assess marketing effectiveness and ROI and redirect investment where appropriate.
Select, manage, and hold external agencies and partners accountable for outcomes.
Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing marketing team.
Establish effective ways of working across Marketing, Business Development, Product, and Delivery.
Provide concise, decision-oriented marketing reporting and recommendations to the leadership team.

Product Marketing & Sales Enablement

Provide strategic direction and leadership to the Product Marketing & Sales Enablement function while empowering the team to own day-to-day execution.
Ensure clear and differentiated product positioning and messaging.
Oversee development of sales enablement materials, product collateral, and launch programs.
Build a strong portfolio of customer case studies and scientific and commercial proof points.
Ensure competitive intelligence informs product positioning and commercial conversations.
Oversee conference content, scientific publications, white papers, webinars, and product-oriented campaigns.
Ensure Business Development has the narratives, evidence, and materials required to engage priority customers effectively.
Partner with Product, Scientific, and Delivery teams to ensure scientific accuracy and identify compelling evidence and proof points.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

Essential

12+ years of progressive marketing, communications, or corporate marketing experience.
Significant experience in biopharma, biotech, TechBio, AI-enabled drug discovery, or an adjacent scientific technology market.
Strong existing relationships across the biopharma and biotech media, communications, and industry ecosystem.
Demonstrated success positioning a complex scientific or technology company.
Track record of developing founders and senior executives into recognized external thought leaders.
Exceptional corporate narrative, positioning, messaging, and storytelling capabilities.
Experience leading PR agencies and external communications partners.
Ability to understand sophisticated science and technology and translate it effectively for different audiences.
Strong executive presence and the ability to operate credibly with founders, board members, investors, and pharmaceutical executives.
Demonstrated ability to move between strategy and execution while maintaining focus on the highest-value priorities.
Experience leading and developing a small, high-output marketing team.
Strong understanding of how marketing contributes to commercial growth, including target-account engagement and pipeline influence.

Highly Desirable

Experience helping scale an investor-backed company through a significant commercial growth phase.
Strong understanding of pharmaceutical R&D and drug discovery.
Experience creating or positioning a new technology category.
Strong US biopharma network, ideally complemented by European relationships.
Experience with strategic partnerships and joint customer communications.
Experience building an executive thought-leadership program from the ground up.
Experience with account-based marketing in a complex enterprise sales environment.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

Establish a clear and differentiated corporate narrative and positioning for Turbine.
Build a systematic and high-impact founder and executive thought-leadership program.
Increase Turbine's high-quality earned media coverage and share of voice in BioAI and virtual biology.
Build strong relationships with priority journalists, influencers, and industry leaders.
Increase Turbine's visibility and credibility among target biopharma audiences.
Build effective account-based marketing in close partnership with Business Development.
Increase engagement within priority biopharma accounts and demonstrate measurable marketing influence on commercial pipeline.
Create strong alignment between corporate marketing, product marketing, and commercial priorities.
Improve the effectiveness and measurable ROI of Turbine's marketing investment.
Build and develop a scalable, high-performing marketing organization with clear priorities, accountability, and KPIs.

You Are a Turbiner If You Are:

Curious and self-aware: You actively seek to understand new scientific and commercial challenges and maintain a growth mindset.
Continuously improve: You welcome feedback, adapt your approach and apply learnings to achieve better outcomes.
Take ownership: You are independently motivated, proactive and accountable for delivering meaningful results.
Collaborate constructively: You engage in thoughtful, respectful discussion and work across disciplines to achieve the strongest scientific and business outcomes.
Think commercially: You connect scientific innovation to customer needs, business value and measurable impact.
Thrive in ambiguity: You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, identifying opportunities and creating momentum without requiring extensive direction.

Benefits

Compensation:

Base salary: $220K - $250K + target annual bonus of 20% of base salary (performance-based)

Benefits:

401(k) with company match
Comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
You are also eligible for 20 paid vacation days each calendar year accrued per pay period plus 8 days of paid sick leave per calendar year

added.title: Founding Marketing
added.description:
Business unit:
GTM
Compensation:
$120k-$160k, 0.1%-0.25% equity
Reports to:
CoS (Bruce)
Location:
NYC in-person 5 days a week

Overview

Howdy! Bruce here - Chief of Staff at String. If you’re a technical storyteller who speaks the language of engineers, can move fast, and wants to write, film, and build for some of the largest enterprises in the world, I want you to join our team.

At String, we’re building the complete layer for companies to collect, structure, and receive web data. We’ve hit 7-figure ARR, are growing fast
by selling to everyone, from individual devs I meet on X to some of the most powerful financial institutions on the planet ($1T+ AUM). We’ve done it all with a lean team of < 10, with only one initial funding round.

In July, we launched our Web Access API, which allows companies to fetch, search, crawl, map, and browse nearly any site on the internet.

In <2 months from launch, that product reached six figures ARR. We have a ~95%+ conversion rate from trial → purchase, and a ~95% retention rate.

I want to get it in front of more people and companies. I want you to help us do it.

This role would own our inbound sales strategy and execution for the Web Access API. I think of the job as having three responsibilities:
Strategize:
How should we segment our prospects? What are the best places and content formats to reach them?
Create:
Build content (YT videos, blogs, ads, tweets, demos, LI posts, etc.) that show the value of our product to enterprises who use web data to build out their core product offering
Engage:
Meet engineers where they are (discords, subreddits, hacker news, hackathons, stackoverflow) and help them solve their scraping / antibot problems while demonstrating String’s value!

You are either a builder with a creative side or a creative with a technical side, and are excited about being online all day, talking to engineers, while creating data-driven content using one of the largest collections of web data on the planet.

What we do

Today, any business that wants to collect web data has to jump through tons of hoops:
Build infrastructure to send thousands of requests to websites
Build technology to avoid getting detected as a bot (very hard to do at scale)
Code individual scripts for every website they want to scrape
Fix all those scripts as websites change, and
Ensure consistent data quality across runs

We solve all of these problems so that they never have to worry about their web data pipelines. Thus, we 1) significantly improve their end products driving millions in revenue and 2) save them hundreds of thousands of dollars in engineering costs.

We cut our teeth working with hedge funds (6 of the top 10 in AUM are customers) and VC firms (names you’d recognize but I cannot disclose) and are now taking our learnings from working with them to build data solutions for every firm that needs public web data for their product.

Our end customers use our product to
Make better decisions. E.g., “How much is Lululemon discounting their products and should I therefore buy their stock?”
Fundamentally support their core products. E.g. I’m an AI legal tech company and need to scrape tons of legal codes across state & local government websites.

Building this would have been impossible before the AI revolution. We have a unique opportunity to build the first platform where anyone can collect structured data across any website with just a prompt.

What you will do

Write articles showing insights from the datasets that we collect (E.g., deep-dive analysis on the growth of Anduril, comparing success of Lululemon vs. Vuori, analyzing adoption of Chinese vs. US AI models)
Help us get to tens of thousands of followers across LinkedIn and X
Construct personalized demos for the companies we’re targeting
Engage with people asking questions about scraping and antibot on reddit, discord, etc
Set up a slack or discord for all of our users to connect, and run it!
Construct and run a paid ads program
Optimize funnel conversion and create custom landing pages for clients and specific ads
Create short and long form videos that demonstrate product capabilities, provide educational value to developers, and show life at our company!

We’re willing to bet on slope if you can demonstrate a high level of competence or hunger. We have a few must-haves, and the rest is flexible if you rock.

You do have:

Experience writing content (we ask for proof of this in the application)
An NYC home base (or the willingness to move)
Some data or technical experience (Python, Go, Typescript, working with APIs). This is not about expertise, but our product and buyers are technical and you must understand both deeply

You probably have:

1+ years of experience building GTM systems using AI
2+ years of sales or marketing experience
Experience selling $10k-100k ARR deals

Our application is structured in a way that allows you to demonstrate these things rather than just tell us about them. If you copy and paste AI-generated text into the application, I’ll know, and I will throw it in the slopcan :)

Why you'd join us

It isn’t often that a startup is hiring their first marketing employee after already generating 7 figures in ARR. We are in the initial stages of PMF and have by far the best product in the market (the vast majority of our customers have switched from competitors).

The bottleneck now is just getting it in front of buyers. For the right person, this will be an opportunity for immense career growth both to own responsibility beyond the typical marketing role and to move into managing a team much faster than otherwise possible.

This role will transform your career and give you the badge to go on to whatever you want to do next.

We believe you’ll have the skills to be a 10x asset to any startup you join in the future - the type of person that hot startups want to bring in as their first VP of marketing.

We’ve also structured our compensation to be higher than market rate and to include accelerants and equity to ensure we get the best talent. Other benefits include:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible PTO
Free food in office - breakfast, lunch, dinner
NYC office - beautiful office in Chelsea, snacks, drinks, peak startup energy
Unlimited tokens for AI use
Annual international offsite (last 3 years - Marrakech, Istanbul, Kuala Lumpur - we like an adventure!)

Interview process

Initial conversation with Bruce (30 mins)
Conversation with Rohit (30 mins)
Work exercise with Bruce (1 hour)
Work trial in person with full team (1 day)

Team

You should read through our team values to see if working with us will be a good fit for you. If you get excited from reading the values page, it’s likely a good fit and vice versa.

Logan (CTO): Leading engineering and has extensive web scraping & AI experience. Ships like a 10 person engineering team (Rohit bragging for him). Previously worked as the founding engineer at Nourish (YC W21, now unicorn) and as a software engineer at C3 AI. Has arbitraged Polymarket, frontran ICOs & Coinbase listings, and written a chess engine.

Rohit (CEO): Leading GTM and has signed 25+ deals including 6 of the 10 largest hedge funds while spending half his time coding. Previously worked as a consultant at Bain and cofounded two startups in college, one of them with Logan called CampusOven.

Bruce (CoS): Joined from Bain to help supercharge the ops function and grow adoption of our industry-leading Web Access product. Also worked with us during our CampusOven days.

Engineers: We have 7 more great engineers on the team who help build and maintain the full end to end product. We’re lucky to have such passionate and thoughtful engineers on the team.

Growth interns: We have two rockstar interns on the team right now who have already sourced billion-dollar companies and publicly traded enterprises, they’ll be able to help you out!

Compensation

We’re building an exceptional team and so want to be generous on compensation. Our philosophy is that base compensation is for living expenses and equity is for upside. We want you to be able to give your all and benefit proportionately from your contributions, without worrying about living expenses.

So our compensation structure is a base salary competitive with other early-stage startups and generous equity relative to other startups. We know that part of the excitement of joining a startup is the upside and to feel like an owner - that’s why we left our corporate jobs.

Concretely, that means $120-$160k salary with 0.1%-0.25% equity - we are flexible here based on desired mix of cash, equity, and commission

added.title: Social Media Video Content Creator
added.description:
About HYBE Americas

HYBE AMERICAS, a subsidiary of HYBE Corp., is a leading global entertainment and media company at the intersection of music, film, television, technology, brands, culture and social good. HYBE AMERICAS drives innovation across the entertainment landscape through its diverse portfolio, including Blue Highway Records, the publishing company Big Machine Music and Quality Control Music in the U.S., and HYBE’s labels in Latin America and the U.S. Hispanic market. The company represents a powerhouse roster of global artists spanning multiple genres and cultures. With headquarters in Los Angeles, HYBE AMERICAS creates synergistic opportunities for artists, businesses, and brands through its integrated approach to talent development, content creation, and technological innovation that transcends industries.

At HYBE, we believe in the power of music and foster a culture built on Passion, Autonomy, and Trust.

Position Overview

Reporting directly to the Art Director (Evergreen Content & Social Series), the Social Media Video Content Creator is the primary hands-on video creator and editor responsible for bringing the artist and brand to life across social platforms. This role combines a passion for digital storytelling, video production, and internet culture. You will shoot and edit high-volume short-form content (i.e. TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and digital media assets that drive high engagement and keep the fanbase connected daily.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in our Santa Monica office, with in-person collaboration 3 days per week and remote work 2 days per week. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to the greater Los Angeles area at their own expense prior to their start date — we are not offering relocation assistance for this role, though it may be considered on a case-by-case basis for select candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation & Short-Form Editing

Shoot and edit high-quality short-form videos (:15s to 2:00m) for all owned social channels and paid media, filling the content calendar with engaging B-roll, trends, personality clips, and brand integrations.
Bring videos to life through fast-turnaround editing, custom motion graphics, sound design/effects, trending audio, and platform-optimized subtitles.
Format and deliver platform-native video assets tailored specifically for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, e-commerce (including Weverse), and email marketing.

Long-Form Content Creation & Editing

Shoot and edit high-quality long-form videos (5:00-30:00+ minutes) for owned social channels such as YouTube, filling the content calendar with engaging programming. Examples include: Day in the life vlogs, making of/BTS videos, group challenges/activities/travel, performance-focused videos and longer episodic pieces/documentaries.
Bring videos to life through high quality production, fast-turnaround editing, custom motion graphics, sound design/effects, and platform-optimized subtitles.
Format and deliver platform-native video assets tailored specifically for YouTube.

Art Direction Alignment & Creative Execution

Work closely with the Art Directors to execute exact visual guidelines, including lighting styles, camera framing, color profiles, and overall aesthetic direction.
Brainstorm and pitch fresh, culturally relevant content ideas and act quickly on emerging social trends, audio formats, and digital subcultures.
Collaborate with social media and marketing partners to ensure video output ladders up to broader monthly content calendars and brand goals.

Studio & Equipment Management

Maintain the organization, inventory, and operational readiness for the production
Handle physical production logistics, including setting up and tearing down lighting configurations, camera gear, and loose set design and props when needed.

Workflow & Project Management

Manage multiple concurrent editing and shooting projects to consistently meet tight daily and weekly deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Organize and maintain clean post-production project files, raw footage archives, and final social asset libraries.

Qualifications

2–4+ years of hands-on video shooting, editing, and social content creation for a brand, music artist, digital media publisher, or creative agency.
Proficient with mirrorless and digital cinema cameras (Sony, Canon, Blackmagic) as well as mobile shooting setups, with a solid grasp of lighting, composition, and field audio capture.
Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro; proficiency in After Effects, CapCut, and platform-native editing tools is highly valued.
A strong portfolio or social reel highlighting high-engagement short-form videos, creative pacing, motion graphics, sound integration, and strong visual aesthetics.
Deep, native understanding of short-form social video formats, algorithms, and trend lifecycles across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Self-motivated, highly organized, and thriving in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment.
Willingness and ability to travel extensively with artists on tour, on set, and for off-site appearances.

Don't match every skill listed? Almost nobody does! Think you're a good fit anyway? Please let us know.

Salary Range

The salary range for this job is $95,000 to $125,000. This is a good faith effort at the time of posting. This range is base salary only and does not include benefits and any other compensatory components of the role.

Why Join Us

At HYBE Americas, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the voice and reputation of one of the most dynamic and innovative companies in global entertainment. You’ll work with some of the world’s most exciting artists and help tell the stories that define culture. We back our passion for music with benefits that take care of you, so you can bring your best to the work that inspires millions.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Company 401(k) match up to 5%
Flexible paid time off
FSA
Life insurance
Wellhub membership that gives you access to gyms and fitness studios

Position Summary

The Associate Director of Direct Marketing & Participation will manage the development and execution of a sophisticated, omni-channel campaign schedule aimed to drive alumni donor participation, build lifetime loyalty, and raise maximum spendable dollars for WashU’s top Annual Fund priorities. In addition to coordinating the day-to-day aspects of our direct marketing appeals, this role will partner closely with Philanthropic Strategy partners to drive results for schools and programs and oversee faculty and staff giving.

The Associate Director reports to the Senior Director of Annual Giving Programs and will work in close collaboration and partnership with Advancement Communications, Philanthropic Strategy and other internal partners and external vendors. This Associate Director will also manage the Assistant Director who’s duties include premiums, corporate matching gift program, license plate program and Loyalty Society data hygiene.

Job Description

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

Direct Marketing Campaigns And Appeals:

In close collaboration with our Advancement Communications team, plan and coordinate the daily management of a large variety and volume of direct marketing projects.

Ensure the Direct Marketing schedule and all details are up to date in project management tool (Click Up). Track tasks, timelines, and other standard operating procedures within Click Up.
Coordinate direct marketing projects to ensure they are successfully completed on time and within budget; manage vendor relationships and communication, as appropriate.
Facilitate the proofing, editing, review, approval, and production processes for each appeal, as appropriate.
Develop segmentation strategy and other data variables needed for each campaign. Identify, document, and track all testing factors. Build campaign ‘workbooks’ to organize projects based upon appeal versions and audience segmentations. Support data set finalization, merge proofing and testing, and assist in resolving any data-related issues.
Build campaigns and source codes to ensure all appeals are able to be tracked and analyzed.
Work closely with data analyst on data segmentation, variables, and ask strings for appeals.
Work with other direct marketing colleagues to ensure all form links and QR codes have been requested, created and working appropriately.
Secure final approval for all Annual Giving appeals; manage the ‘send’ process for all mass-email communications. I partnership with Advancement Communications.

Loyalty Society:

Develop and implement the strategy of the Loyalty Society program to ensure strong donor retention at all giving levels. Work closely with the Assistant Director and Data Analyst to ensure Loyalty Society data is clean.

School/Program Liaison:

In collaboration with Annual Giving leadership, Advancement Communications, and our school and unit partners, support the execution of unit-specific Annual Fund appeal and project requests in accordance to standard operating procedures.

Faculty And Staff Giving:

Oversee strategy development and manage the day-to-day activities of our faculty and staff giving program.
Develop strategic communications plan to engage and solicit WashU staff and faculty.
Coordinate payroll deduction retention, renewal, and acquisition efforts; ensure stewardship touches are planned and appropriate benefits/communications are being issued.

Other duties as assigned – work closely with Executive Director and Senior Director to provide any additional support needed to ensure donor participation goals are met.

Normal office environment.
Ability and willingness to work evenings and weekends as necessary as well as travel to on- and off-campus locations.

Typically sitting at a desk or table.
